text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on first day of visit to Rome meets with his Italian counterpart Oscar Luigi Scalfaro.
- President Ben Ali says in interview with Italian daily paper "Corriere Della Sera" that Islam with tolerance and moderation as in Tunisia does not allow fundamentalist perversion.
- Libya and Jordan aim to profit from the experience of Tunisia in the environment sector.

- Industry Minister Slaheddine Bouguerra meets visiting Saudi chairman of Societe Saoudienne Generale d'Electrecite, Mahmoud Abdallah Tiba, who said cooperation between Tunisia and Saudia Arabia will be boosted in the near future on exploration and production of electrical energy.
- Mohamed Attia named chairmen of Banque Tuniso-Qatarie d'Investissement (BTQI).
- Tunisia and Egypt aim to modernise agriculture sector in the two countries.
- Good start for tourism in Mahdia, the central resort of Tunisia. Number of tourist nights rose by 51.3 percent during April 1997 compared with the same period in 1996.
